actual: With reportsPageAccess ON and timesheetsView OFF, /reports lists 'Timesheet Activities' (route /reports/punch-clock-activities); it opened as the default report view

title: Timesheets card columns: spec/tech-plan canonical = View + Create and Edit (no Delete)
expected: Timesheets card title 'Timesheets'; two columns 'View' and 'Create and Edit' with NO Delete (post CRP-FE-03)

reason: Canonical post-CRP-FE-03 column set (View + Create & Edit, no Delete) is present; subtitle copy variance noted but non-blocking (title + columns match)

title: Clock in/out is ALWAYS available regardless of Timesheets permission
role_used: ZZAUTOTEST custom role as Tech (timesheets OFF)
expected: A basic clock in/out control is universally available and records attendance
actual: For the bare workOrdersView-only Tech no clock in/out control appeared in the top nav, avatar menu, WO list, or WO detail. reason: Could not confirm 'always available' for this custom role; clock-in appears gated by staff/department clock-capability which was not configurable here - needs manual setup
